summary: The Wizard uses the debug wish command to obtain a scroll of earth, then reads it with 'r' and selects it with 'p'. C dispatches the ordinary, unblessed, uncursed, unconfused scroll to read.c:seffect_earth() on a level with a ceiling, prints the ceiling-rumbling message, marks the scroll known, and creates boulders. JavaScript's read.c seffects() switch currently calls note_unported('read.c seffect_earth'), so the effect message and boulder path are skipped. The three C-only rnd(2) draws reported under mkobj.c:next_ident are downstream object-identity draws from the missing effect, not its source owner.

source.branch: seffect_earth() enters when the level is not a Rogue level, has a ceiling, and is outside the endgame (or is the Earth level). For this recording the scroll is unblessed, uncursed, and the hero is not confused or swallowed: C reports the ceiling rumbling above the hero, marks the effect known, drops boulders on eligible surrounding squares, and drops one on the player.
callers: read.c:doread() calls seffects(), whose SCR_EARTH switch arm calls seffect_earth(); js/read.js:doread() calls js/read.js:seffects(), whose SCR_EARTH arm currently records the unported gap.
dependencies: read.c:drop_boulder_on_monster() returns a count that seffect_earth() adds to nboulders and tests for the blessed-scroll fallback; include this return-valued callee in the source family.

read.c:drop_boulder_on_player() creates and places the unblessed player boulder. Its mksobj() object creation reaches mkobj.c:next_ident(), which accounts for the C-only RNG entries at this case’s first mismatch.
Preserve the effect ordering through gk.known, sokoban_guilt(), object creation/placement, and doread() cleanup and scroll consumption.

evidence: The saved evaluation challenges/evaluations/20260926140428-v6.json at c79e03cbb8b5e5509ef1f09c67f9c94405b25eae reports one remaining screen at segment 0 step 20 on key "p": row 0 column 38 is a space in C and the More-prompt dash in JavaScript; the C cursor is [78,0,1] versus JavaScript [46,0,1]. The C RNG entries at indices 2454–2456 are three rnd(2) calls from mkobj.c:next_ident().

The recipe challenges/cases/v6/wizard-read-earth-reach.recipe.session.json uses seed 60626037, a chaotic female human Wizard, and moves " \u0017scroll of earth\nrp". In the recording, the wizard-wish input creates the scroll, key "r" opens read selection, and key "p" selects it at segment 0 step 20. C prints "As you read the scroll, it disappears.  The ceiling rumbles above you!--More--"; the JavaScript gap lets its More prompt begin earlier.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/read.c seffect_earth() (1919–1970) checks the ceiling and level gates, prints the rumble or avalanche message, sets gk.known, and loops over the eight surrounding squares to call drop_boulder_on_monster(); an unblessed scroll also calls drop_boulder_on_player(). The seffects() SCR_EARTH case dispatches to it (around line 2273).

At the evaluated implementation, js/read.js seffects() has an SCR_EARTH arm that calls note_unported("read.c seffect_earth") (around line 1302); js/read.js doread() reaches seffects() after printing the read message (around line 845). The screen and next_ident RNG differences are consequences of this skipped C effect; mkobj.c:next_ident() is not the source owner.
